parts.text: Which description of the mosquito stages is correct?

options.text: The adult mosquito stays in the rainwater throughout its life.
The wriggling form and the comma-shaped form belong to different species sharing the tyre.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Rohit watches a discarded tyre that holds rainwater. He sees wriggling forms, then quieter comma-shaped forms, before winged adults leave the water.

part_answers.answer: The wriggling larva comes before the quieter pupa; adults leave the water, so the order is egg, larva, pupa, adult.

teacher.key_rationale: Mosquitoes develop egg → larva → pupa → adult. Observation of wriggling then comma-shaped forms places larva before pupa. Adults leave the water; larva and pupa are stages of one species.
